projectDescription: HelpAlive is a guidance layer for B2B SaaS — an in-product AI assistant trained on your docs, plus adoption insights drawn from real usage. Three shipped components: a lightweight browser SDK, a context-aware chatbot, and an adoption analytics dashboard.
keyFeatures: Lightweight browser SDK (~11 KB) with autocapture for clicks, pageviews, form submits, rage clicks, DOM errors, and per-page exposure summaries
AI product assistant — Preact widget in Shadow DOM, hybrid retrieval (vector + BM25 + RRF), cross-encoder rerank, Claude streaming over SSE
Knowledge-base ingestion from URL crawl or file upload (PDF, DOCX, MD), chunked + embedded into pgvector with HNSW
Draft / publish workflow for chatbot config, knowledge sources, and guidance — atomic publishes, Test page preview
Coverage-gaps inbox — every user question classified (no_retrieval / weak_retrieval / negative_rating), HDBSCAN-clustered, ranked by volume × gap
Adoption analytics — per-user, per-tenant, per-page activity views
Two-layer PII redaction — client-side pattern stripping, then server-side Microsoft Presidio in a dedicated drainer (the only service with raw event access)
DSAR-ready privacy tooling — async deletion jobs, audit trail, suppression for tenants and users
Consent modes (auto / required) with runtime toggle
publicApiSurface: npm: import HelpAlive from '@helpalive/sdk'; HelpAlive.init({ apiKey })
identify({ userId, tenantId, displayName?, email?, role?, plan?, createdAt? }) — userId and tenantId required
getContext() returns ChatbotContext for the widget
startGuide(guide, opts?), cancelGuide(), preloadGuides({ ids }), getActiveGuideController(), onGuideStarted(callback)
